title: Design a Distributed Key-Value Store
prompt: Design a distributed key-value store (think DynamoDB/Cassandra style) that supports get(key) and put(key, value) with high availability, and can scale horizontally across many nodes.
requirements: Functional: get/put by key, horizontal scaling by adding nodes
Non-functional: must stay available during network partitions or node failures, should scale to a very large number of keys and high request volume
discussion_points: Partitioning scheme (consistent hashing) and how it handles adding/removing nodes
Replication strategy and quorum reads/writes (e.g. N/W/R)
Consistency model tradeoffs — where this system lands on the CAP theorem, and why
Conflict resolution when concurrent writes to the same key diverge
Failure detection and how the system recovers a failed node's data
